module: Flowgraph node 'Procedural Static CamPath' (once_p_duration category). Creates a camera path with two identical keys (position pos, rotation rot, FOV 60) to display a fixed viewpoint, registers it via camera:addCustomPath and outputs its unique name on 'pathName'.
notes: The code comment says the category should be f_duration but that there is no end callback.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

workOnce.desc: Builds the two markers (duration 1000), generates a unique name (node id + 'pcp') and adds the path to the camera module.
